name: Watermelon Burst | Melted Diamond Live Resin Vaporizer | 1.0g (Reload)
description:
DIAMONDS INSIDE 
Our live resin diamonds, extracted from fresh frozen flowers, use a gradual separation process creating large faceted diamond-like crystals. The 99%+ potency diamond crystals are then liquefied, producing the highest potency vaporizers on the market. 
Taste, and feel, a rainbow of effects with this fruity strain that is mouth-wateringly delicious. Earthy, herbaceous undertones and bright fruity citrus meet with a sour overtone that turns slightly pungent in this delicious strain. Despite its bright and complex nose, Watermelon Burst’s effects are best suited for a chill night lazing on the couch or catching some zzz's. 
Watermelon 
Berry 
Earthy
